name: Multinomial Logistic Regression
when_to_use: Nominal categorical dependent variable with three or more unordered categories.

expected_input.question: How to predict the probability of a category?

plain_explanation.purpose: Calculates the chance of each of several possible categories (more than two) from factors.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the outcome is a choice among three or more options with no natural order.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A categorical response column with 3+ values and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Predict which of 3 plans a customer will choose, based on their profile.
plain_explanation.diagram: factors -> [model] -> chance of plan A, B and C (sum to 100%)
